opening.argument: The presentation promotes passive node returns through concrete earnings claims and participation instructions. The speaker reports, "at first I bought 11 nodes and now I got 39 nodes," says a Polygon node is "supposed to make 0.125 per node per day," and describes lending Bitcoin to Yield Nodes, where investors receive part of the rewards. He also describes compounding profits monthly, while directing viewers toward participation through description links and a wallet for sending Strong tokens. The suggestion that node rewards could recover an investment in a couple of months reinforces the apparent return mechanism. Warnings about crypto risk, fake sites, and seed-phrase requests provide protective context, but they do not remove the promotional structure.
